newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai to boost biotech, drugs industries.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai to boost biotech, drugs industries.

text.p: Shanghai plans to upgrade its biotechnology and pharmaceutical sector into a "pillar industry" in the next few years, the China Daily Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The city wants to increase the value of the industry's output to 16 billion yuan in 1997 and 80 billion yuan by the year 2000, the newspaper said. Output reached 12 billion yuan in 1996, it said.
It said several big pharmaceutical enterprise groups will be set up with one or two of them reaching an annual output value of five billion yuan each by the end of the century.
